title: Give the reader compact defaults; add the root-cause default
summary: The reader's render() will show each default's id, classes and only the first sentence of its statement, while producer and verifier briefs keep the full statement. Then add the 'root-cause' default with its full meaning, with no new defaults.toml field, because the installed gate rejects unknown fields.

defaults_applied.how: All changes are Rust and TOML; no new non-Rust files.
Add unit tests for compact rendering; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change: compact reader form plus the new default.
A test enforces that render is compact and briefs stay full.
Doc comments explain the compact rule for an outside reader.
No secrets or personal data in the change.
The verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
I recovered the schema and gate constraints from the repository.

assumptions: The installed gate parses defaults.toml with the old structs, which use deny_unknown_fields (crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs; gate content.rs:89). A new field would fail it, so I add none.
The compact form is derived in code: the statement up to its first sentence end, with the rest only in briefs. Existing statements are mostly one sentence, so they are unchanged.

The root-cause statement starts with a one-sentence gist such as 'Fix where the fault originates, not the symptom or the one instance that surfaced.' Later sentences carry the out-of-scope-cause rule, the description rule, and the relation to 'small'.
The root-cause entry applies_to is code, config, build, docs, tests, prompts, design (or '*'), with source 'BRIEF.md 2026-10-13: Root causes'. I cannot read BRIEF.md here.
Token budgets in athena.toml are not touched. The reader set should fall well under 1800 once the new entry is added.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml has a new [[default]] id 'root-cause' with a full statement covering: fix where the fault originates, not the symptom or the one instance; name an out-of-scope cause and propose the fix instead of working around it; the change description names the root cause and why the change addresses it; the root-cause fix is the one focused change ('small'). Its source cites BRIEF.md '2026-10-13: Root causes'.
defaults.toml adds no new field, and DefaultsModel and Default keep their fields (deny_unknown_fields intact), so the installed gate parses the file.
DefaultsModel::render() emits a compact form of each default (id, classes, first sentence of the statement). The briefs code in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs still uses the full statement.

Run cargo test -p athena-data and cargo test -p athena-context. New tests pass: render drops statement text after the first sentence for a multi-sentence default, the briefs keep the full statement, and the repo defaults.toml parses and contains 'root-cause'.
Run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check. All pass, including existing budget tests that load defaults.toml.
athena.toml budgets and BRIEF.md are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Raising any token budget in athena.toml
Adding a new defaults.toml field or changing the parse schema
Changes to the producer or verifier brief layout
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: the change touches governance (defaults.toml) and shared rendering code, and the gate-compatibility constraint adds verifier checks.
